source: designer's colour document (brand-guide/stick-colour-font.pdf, supplied by Christelle 2026-10-20); measured feed tokens kept for existing templates

primary.name: brand navy
primary.usage: designer's main colour: dominant fields, headlines on light tiles, the logo colour

neutral_mid.name: brand grey
neutral_mid.usage: designer's second colour: light tiles, secondary shapes, dividers

neutral_light.name: white
neutral_light.usage: text on navy, white logo on navy and photos

accent.name: teal
accent.usage: optional accent where a design calls for it (Christelle, 2026-10-20). Not in the designer's two-colour document; measured from the feed

supporting.name: mint
supporting.usage: optional accent, sparingly. Measured from the feed, not in the designer's document

palette.accent_rule: Navy and grey are the brand. Teal and mint are acceptable accents only where a design calls for it.
